department: Cumming School of Medicine, Medical Science Graduate Program

deadline.value: International applicants for September 2027 apply by April 1, 2027 (May entry: December 1; January entry: August 1). Year inferred.

gre_general.value: The program lists no required test scores, so the GRE is not needed.

gre_subject.value: No subject GRE exists for this field and the program page lists no test scores.

supervisor.value: You must list potential supervisors when you apply.
supervisor.quote: A supervisor is required; potential supervisors must be listed when applying to the program

funding.value: Every full-time PhD student is guaranteed at least CAD 33,205 a year (international; CAD 31,426 domestic) for the first four years, if progress stays satisfactory.
funding.quote: Full-time PhD students beginning their program on or after January 1, 2026, are guaranteed a minimum funding package of $31,426 for domestic students and $33,205 for international students. | These annual amounts are guaranteed for the first four years of a PhD program

entry_route.value: An MSc or other relevant master's is required; a four-year BSc is accepted only in exceptional cases.
entry_route.quote: An MSc or other relevant Master's degree.

also.quote: or, in exceptional cases, four year BSc degree or equivalent

toefl_min.value: Cumming School of Medicine programs need TOEFL iBT 105 with no section below 20 (or 5 on the new scale for tests after January 21, 2026).
toefl_min.quote: a minimum TOEFL internet based score of 105 (with no section less than 20) (for tests taken prior to January 21, 2026) | a minimum TOEFL internet based score of 5 (with minimum section scores of 4.0 in reading, writing and speaking and 4.5 in listening)

ielts_min.value: Cumming School of Medicine programs need IELTS 7.5 overall with no band below 6.0.
ielts_min.quote: a minimum IELTS overall band score of 7.5 (with no individual band less than 6.0)

notes: The Cumming School of Medicine also runs separate PhDs in Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, Cardiovascular and Respiratory Sciences, Immunology, Microbiology and Infectious Diseases, and Gastrointestinal Sciences.
name: Medical Science PhD
